literal_meaning: onomatopoeic expression evoking roughness or hardness, like clattering or uneven sounds
example_sentences_in_bangla: খটমট বিষয় নিয়ে চিন্তা করতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: This math problem is very complicated.
We have to think about this tricky matter.
note: Primarily used in spoken Bengali to describe challenging concepts or situations.
